eligibility_rule: A pre-existing edited target is eligible only when the intended family action completes, identity/scene/camera remain visually stable, and the instruction does not deliberately add gaze, prop, appearance, secondary-actor, or other event changes.

rows.raw_prompt: Make the person stand up straight, holding the wooden stick vertically in front of them.
rows.review_note: Stand completes, but the stick moves from the side into a new frontal vertical pose.

rows.raw_prompt: Make the dog sit down on the seaweed, looking attentively at the camera.
rows.review_note: Sit completes; the dog already faces the camera and identity, harness, beach, and framing remain stable.

rows.raw_prompt: Make the dog sit down in the snow, looking directly forward with alert expression.
rows.review_note: Sit completes, but the target also rotates the dog's head and body from a side gaze to frontal.

rows.raw_prompt: Make the man stand up fully, positioned slightly behind the plant.
rows.review_note: The target remains kneeling/crouched in all reviewed frames and never reaches an upright stand.

rows.raw_prompt: Make the dog sit down on the pavement.
rows.review_note: Pure sit completes with the same dog, patio, tennis ball, camera, and framing.

rows.raw_prompt: Make the dog sit down on its hind legs, facing forward.
rows.review_note: Sit completes; the dog already faces forward and the woodland scene remains stable.

rows.raw_prompt: Make the dog lie down on its stomach with its head resting on its paws.
rows.review_note: The source is a valid dog stand anchor, but the pre-existing target is lie-down rather than sit-down.

rows.raw_prompt: Make the person stand up, holding one basketball in each hand.
rows.review_note: Stand completes, but the second basketball moves from the ground into the other hand.

rows.raw_prompt: Make the man stand up straight, maintaining his embrace with the girl at his side.
rows.review_note: Stand completes while the already-present child and embrace remain stable.

rows.raw_prompt: Make the boy stand up and hold the trophy with both hands, lifting it slightly off the ice.
rows.review_note: Stand completes, but the trophy also moves from the ice into both hands.

rows.raw_prompt: Make the man stand up straight and have the dog sit beside him.
rows.review_note: The man stands, but the dog simultaneously performs a second sit event.

rows.raw_prompt: Make the dog sit down on the grass.
rows.review_note: Pure sit completes with stable identity, lawn, pool, camera, and framing.

rows.raw_prompt: Make the dog sit down with its front paws extended forward and head tilted slightly to the left.
rows.review_note: Sit completes, but the instruction deliberately couples paw placement and head tilt.

rows.raw_prompt: Make the dog sit down with its mouth closed and tongue retracted.
rows.review_note: Sit completes, but mouth/tongue state changes are an explicit simultaneous event.

rows.raw_prompt: Make the adult Spiderman stand up fully and place his left arm around the child's shoulder.
rows.review_note: Stand completes, but a new arm-around-child interaction is added.

rows.raw_prompt: Make the person stand up with their arms relaxed by their side.
rows.review_note: Stand completes; relaxed arms are treated as the natural terminal pose rather than a separate event.

rows.raw_prompt: Make the dog sit down in the snow, facing the camera.
rows.review_note: Sit completes, but the target suppresses the source's registered natural head turn and fixes frontal gaze.

rows.raw_prompt: Make the person stand up and hold the sword vertically with the tip pointing upward.
rows.review_note: Stand completes, but the sword is deliberately reoriented into a new vertical pose.
